name: Shuttle Flight
placementTarget: Back of each player reference card.
summary: Dark action strip. Shuttle Flight: move from any haven or supply center to any other haven or supply center on the grid. Same rule as the Rules H sticker, shortened for the player reference.

mechanics.timing: Action, matching the Rules H sticker.
mechanics.effect: Move from any haven or supply center to any other haven or supply center on the grid.
restrictions: The origin must be a haven or a supply center.
The destination must be a different haven or supply center on the grid.
Sticker 03 says to place this strip on the back of each player reference card. The manifest counts 1 image.
